verdict.rationale: Statsig is a SaaS platform with a Console API, HTTP API, CLI and MCP server, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question. The evidence never describes creating scoped, read-only or least-privilege API keys. The access-management material covers SSO/SCIM for human users, and target apps scope which gates and configs apply to an application, not what a credential is allowed to do.
